name: nova-act
description: The Nova Act service provides a REST API for managing AI-powered workflow automation.

subcommands.name: create-act
subcommands.description: Creates a new AI task (act) within a session that can interact with tools and perform specific actions.

subcommands.name: create-session
subcommands.description: Creates a new session context within a workflow run to manage conversation state and acts.

subcommands.name: create-workflow-definition
subcommands.description: Creates a new workflow definition template that can be used to execute multiple workflow runs.

subcommands.name: create-workflow-run
subcommands.description: Creates a new execution instance of a workflow definition with specified parameters.

subcommands.name: delete-workflow-definition
subcommands.description: Deletes a workflow definition and all associated resources.

subcommands.name: delete-workflow-run
subcommands.description: Terminates and cleans up a workflow run, stopping all associated acts and sessions.

subcommands.name: get-workflow-definition
subcommands.description: Retrieves the details and configuration of a specific workflow definition.

subcommands.name: get-workflow-run
subcommands.description: Retrieves the current state, configuration, and execution details of a workflow run.

subcommands.name: invoke-act-step
subcommands.description: Executes the next step of an act, processing tool call results and returning new tool calls if needed.

subcommands.name: list-acts
subcommands.description: Lists all acts within a specific session with their current status and execution details.

subcommands.name: list-models
subcommands.description: Lists all available AI models that can be used for workflow execution, including their status and compatibility information.

subcommands.name: list-sessions
subcommands.description: Lists all sessions within a specific workflow run.

subcommands.name: list-workflow-definitions
subcommands.description: Lists all workflow definitions in your account with optional filtering and pagination.

subcommands.name: list-workflow-runs
subcommands.description: Lists all workflow runs for a specific workflow definition with optional filtering and pagination.

subcommands.name: update-act
subcommands.description: Updates an existing act's configuration, status, or error information.

subcommands.name: update-workflow-run
subcommands.description: Updates the configuration or state of an active workflow run.
